summary: Master UX/UI Architecture & Implementation Plan for Category 8 (B2B Trading & Commercial Management). Solves competitor menu-bloat by consolidating 20+ fragmented screens into 4 focused, tabbed operational hubs (Sales Hub, Procurement Hub, Warehouse Inventory, and B2B Directory), enforces progressive disclosure (1 primary action per screen, advanced fiscal/retention settings hidden until needed), creation in modals, and 100% trilingual synchronization (French, Arabic RTL, English).
